entries.title: Latest 1,000-world ballistic batch
entries.description: 592/1000 verified landings, versus 562: 75 gains and 45 former wins not reproduced (33 verified stops and 12 unverified errors). Overall, 392 verified airborne stops and 16 unverified terrain-domain errors remain. The batch's recorded-only loss headline omits those 12 former wins. Start with the mission shortcuts below; the retained policy-3 sweep still lands 817/1000 and no replacement is accepted.
entries.status: 9 Oct · 592 landed · 392 finite stops · 16 unverified · not adopted

entries.title: Latest preservation panel
entries.description: The smaller body-centering comparison: 10/16 random landings versus 8, gaining 142/715 without losing prior candidate landings. All three direct controls land, but changed terminal commands fail the earlier exact-flight admission. The full sweep uses a separate outcome-based contract; controls and repeats stay outside the random denominator.
entries.status: 9 Oct · 10/16 random landings · exact-flight admission failed

entries.title: Previous preservation panel · coast-to-terminal · 8/16

entries.title: Planner V2 · retained policy-3 1,000-world sweep · failure review
entries.description: Retained paired early-exit run: 748 → 817 verified landings on the same worlds, cap 24 in both runs. Review 183 remaining stops: 65 not launched, 83 after handoffs, 35 without a next trajectory. Each rich detail shows recorded state-aware proposals at launch and each actual H, proposed conflicts, correction state changes and saved give-up reasons. Start with 715, then 280/983. Group navigation and all rich views remain. Diagnostic reconstruction only; no changed flights or held-out reliability claim.
entries.status: Experimental cap 24 · 817/1000 landed · 183 stops to review

entries.title: Planner V2 · previous 1,000-world terrain sweep · cap comparison
entries.description: Previous paired development check: the same 1,000 worlds under correction caps 6 and 24. 733 → 748 verified landings, all prior successes preserved; 387 clear direct and 361 blocked-route landings. Use the retained policy-3 early-exit sweep above for its 817-landed / 183-stopped review. This retained report keeps rich plots, handoffs and separate controls/repeats. Production stays cap 6; not held-out reliability or the accepted benchmark.

entries.title: Planner V2 · intervention timing comparison
entries.description: Frozen 16-case diagnostic comparison: three baseline landings versus six with conflict-relative timing. Four new landings, but random-054 and the existing ridge CLI test regress. Candidate not adopted; previous timing restored. Open random-035 for a gain and random-054 for the lost control.

entries.title: Planner V2 · harder terrain challenge
entries.description: Held-out 100-case development population: 64 initially blocked routes, 21 corrected landings; all 36 clear routes landed. Retains 43 finite planning stops, actual handoffs up to six, three preservation controls and five exact repeats. Not the accepted benchmark.

entries.title: Planner V2 · harder-terrain calibration
entries.description: Separate 24-case recipe calibration: 15 initially blocked routes, six corrected landings and nine clear direct landings. All four global recipes retained unchanged for the independent 100-case challenge; these are not held-out trials.

entries.title: Planner V2 · full random-terrain sweep
entries.description: Preserved clear-route sanity baseline: 100/100 frozen random cases verified landed, all with direct clear routes. Separate controls demonstrate one and three executed handoffs; all five repeats agree. Harder blocked-route coverage and the accepted benchmark remain separate.

entries.title: Planner V2 · comparison-aware terrain recheck
entries.description: Earlier stopped pass on the same 100 frozen worlds. Direct control accepted; corrected control landed with passing proofs but stopped on diagnostic-derived proposal hashes. Zero random flights attempted; preserved history, not the accepted benchmark.

entries.title: Planner V2 · numerical-fix terrain recheck
entries.description: Same 100 frozen procedural worlds. Stopped at the first preservation control on a clearance-only numerical mismatch; zero random flights attempted. Separate from the accepted benchmark and original stopped survey.

entries.title: Planner V2 · procedural terrain survey
entries.description: 100 frozen procedural worlds; four random flights attempted, three verified landings. Stopped on a replay guard error with 96 unattempted; not the accepted benchmark.
